shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A woman in a red shirt sits in the patio-side aisle seat and asks about sharing breakfast with a neighbor family, a woman in a green shirt sits in the sideboard-side aisle seat, a man in an orange shirt sits in the sideboard-side window seat, and a woman in a white shirt sits in the patio-side window seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the patio doors end, looking along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the sideboard in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a green shirt asks about giving away the meal, and a woman in a red shirt explains the plan.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the window side, centered on the two adjacent aisle-side seats.

shots.content: A man in an orange shirt agrees with a woman in a red shirt to share the breakfast, and a woman in a green shirt replies.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the dining table.
